name: Grilled Fish with Lemon and Rosemary
subtitle: Whole fish grilled over rosemary with bright lemon
description: A simple barbecue preparation for tender whole fish scented with rosemary and finished with lemon and olive oil.

ingredients.item: sea breams or sea bass (about 600g each)
ingredients.preparation: or 4 mackerel, scaled and gutted (remove the fins and heads, if you prefer)

ingredients.item: olive oil plus extra for drizzling

instructions.text: Preheat the barbecue to medium-high heat.
Set the fish on a clean work surface. Prepare the rosemary, slice the lemons, and measure the olive oil.
Drizzle the fish with the olive oil, then place some rosemary sprigs on the barbecue and set the fish over them.
Cook for about 10 minutes per side, turning carefully, until the thickest part reaches 145°F, or the flesh is opaque and flakes easily.
Cut the fish into portions and serve with the sliced and halved lemons, rosemary, and extra olive oil for drizzling.
